# Generated agent files — do not edit here

One file per roster seat, written by `bin/brain os agents --write` from `docs/inventory/agent-roster.md` and `integrations/agent-os/agents.json`. `install-mac.sh` links them into `~/.claude/agents` without overwriting a file that already exists there, so a hand-tuned prompt on the Mac wins. 178 files as of the last run. Seats with a hand-written file in `.claude/agents/` are not generated here.
